key.name: focus-taskbar
key.summary: Move the keyboard focus to the taskbar (again: the next program)

key.name: focus-tray
key.summary: Move the keyboard focus to the notification area

key.name: minimize-or-restore
key.summary: Restore a maximized or tiled window, otherwise minimize it

key.name: open-start-menu
key.summary: Open the Start menu, to search (the same as Super alone)

key.name: where-am-i
key.summary: Say the program, window, desktop and open windows

key.name: recognize-window
key.summary: Recognize the text of the window in use (OCR) and show it as plain text

key.name: recognize-screen
key.summary: Recognize the text of the whole screen (OCR) and show it as plain text

key.name: dictation
key.summary: Dictation: listen, then write what was said where the cursor is (again: stop)
